## Try It Out!
### Send admin email alerts for new Sharetribe transactions via Gmail

Notify marketplace admins when a transaction payment is confirmed. This filters out intermediate transaction states so you only get notified about completed payments.

### How it works
* The Sharetribe Trigger polls for `transaction/transitioned` events.
* An IF node filters for the `transition/confirm-payment` transition, ensuring only confirmed payments trigger a notification.
* The Asset Get node retrieves your marketplace's email template text.
* Gmail sends the admin a notification with transaction details.

### How to set up
1. Connect your Sharetribe credentials (Client ID and Client Secret from Console > Build > Applications).
2. Connect your Gmail account.
3. Update the "To" field with your admin email address.
4. If your transaction process uses a different transition name for payment confirmation, update the IF node.
5. Activate the workflow.

### Requirements
* Sharetribe marketplace with Integration API credentials
* Gmail account
* At least one completed transaction for testing

### How to customize
* Add additional Sharetribe Get nodes to fetch customer/provider/listing details for richer email content.
* Modify the transition filter for different transaction states.
* Replace Gmail with Slack for team notifications.

Need help? Visit the [n8n Community](https://community.n8n.io/) or [Sharetribe Docs](https://www.sharetribe.com/docs/).

## 1. Listen for transitions
Polls for `transaction/transitioned` events. Transactions go through many states — this captures every transition.

## 2. Filter for confirmed payments
Only continues if the transition is `transition/confirm-payment`. This prevents notifications for every intermediate state change.

## 3. Get email text & notify
Retrieves marketplace email copy and sends the admin notification via Gmail.
